name: Database scoreboard
description: One card per database with active connection count and a saturation bar. Bind 'databases' to 'postgresql.backends' with split-by 'postgresql.database.name' so each row in the metric becomes a card. Threshold colors flag DBs nearing their share of the connection budget.

spec.template:
{{#each databases as db}}
{{ default db.key '(none)' }}
{{ format db.value 'none' 0 }}
active connections
{{/each}} {{#if databases.length}}{{else}}
Bind a metric split by postgresql.database.name (e.g. postgresql.backends) to see one card per database.
{{/if}}
spec.styles: .dbs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr)); gap: 0.6rem; padding: 0.75rem; align-content: start; } .dbs .card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.7rem 0.85rem 0.85rem; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 5%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 14%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-md); min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; transition: border-color 250ms ease-out; } .dbs .card.vellum-th-warn { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-amber-500) 55%, transparent); } .dbs .card.vellum-th-bad  { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-rust-500) 65%, transparent); } .dbs .head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; } .dbs .ico { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; color: var(--color-graphite-500); flex: 0 0 auto; } .dbs .name { font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .dbs .dot { width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-sage-500); flex: 0 0 auto; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-sage-500) 22%, transparent); } .dbs .card.vellum-th-warn .dot { background: var(--color-amber-500); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-amber-500) 25%, transparent); } .dbs .card.vellum-th-bad  .dot { background: var(--color-rust-500);  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-rust-500)  28%, transparent); } .dbs .value { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; margin-top: 0.15rem; } .dbs .card.vellum-th-warn .value { color: var(--color-amber-600); } .dbs .card.vellum-th-bad  .value { color: var(--color-rust-600); } .dbs .lbl { font-size: 0.62rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--color-graphite-500); margin-top: 0.05rem; } .dbs .bar { height: 0.32rem; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 12%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); overflow: hidden; margin-top: 0.45rem; } .dbs .fill { height: 100%; background: var(--color-sage-500); transition: width 600ms ease-out; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); } .dbs .card.vellum-th-warn .fill { background: var(--color-amber-500); } .dbs .card.vellum-th-bad  .fill { background: var(--color-rust-500);  } .dbs .empty { padding: 1rem; text-align: center; color: var(--color-graphite-500); font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.4; grid-column: 1 / -1; } .dbs .empty code { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.78rem; padding: 0.05rem 0.35rem; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 10%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }

dataBindings.name: databases
dataBindings.description: postgresql.backends split by postgresql.database.name — one entry per DB
